blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `hasEntity` method. This belongs to the Settings Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).

Check if an entity exists by name.
Supports PascalCase, kebab-case, snake\_case, and plural forms.

types.name: name
types.description: The name of the entity to check for.

types.name: boolean
types.description: Whether an entity with the specified name exists.
